description: Lawful Development Certificate to confirm that a material operation lawfully commenced pursuant to planning permission Ref. 1331/APP/2022/2553 and that, as a consequence, the permission has been lawfully implemented and remains extant.
decision_conditions: It is hereby certified that the operations described in the 'Description of development' hereto in respect of the land specified in the 'Location of development' hereto and edged in red on the Location Plan (drawing number A01 Rev.A) attached to this certificate, would have been lawful within the meaning of Section 191 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended), for the following reason:

The works carried out at the application site prior to 5th July 2026 commenced the development authorised by planning permission ref: 1331/APP/2022/2553, such that this permission remains extant. Completion of the authorised development in accordance with the terms and conditions of planning permission ref: 1331/APP/2022/2553, would therefore be covered by an express grant of planning permission and so would be lawful.
